fields.name: job_name
fields.label: Job name
fields.help: A label for this run and its results.

fields.name: pdb_path
fields.label: Backbone structure
fields.help: A single protein backbone to design or score. Leave chains blank to use every chain.
fields.help_note: Upload a PDB or mmCIF, or choose a preset with an included structure. mmCIF is converted to PDB and requires single-character chain IDs.

fields.name: pdb_path_chains
fields.label: Chains to design or score
fields.help: Space-separated chain IDs, e.g. A C. Other chains supply fixed sequence and structural context. Blank selects all chains.

fields.name: path_to_fasta
fields.label: Sequences to score (FASTA)
fields.help: Optional sequences for score-only mode. The native sequence is also scored.
fields.help_note: Supply one sequence per FASTA record, with designed chains in alphabetical order separated by /. Each chain must match its parsed backbone length.

fields.name: model_name
fields.label: Model checkpoint
fields.help: 48-neighbor models trained with backbone noise of 0.02, 0.10, 0.20 or 0.30 angstroms. CA-only weights are available through v_48_020.

fields.name: use_soluble_model
fields.label: Use soluble-protein weights
fields.help: Use weights trained on soluble proteins. Cannot be combined with CA-only mode.

fields.name: ca_only
fields.label: Use CA-only structures and weights
fields.help: Use only alpha-carbon coordinates. Requires a CA-only checkpoint; v_48_030 is unavailable.

fields.name: num_seq_per_target
fields.label: Samples per target
fields.help: Sequences per temperature in design mode; repeated evaluations in score/probability modes. Must be a multiple of batch size.
fields.help_note: This service accepts up to 1,000 samples per target.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.label: Batch size
fields.help: Samples processed together. Reduce if GPU memory runs out. Must divide the sample count exactly.

fields.name: sampling_temp
fields.label: Sampling temperatures
fields.help: One or more positive temperatures separated by spaces, e.g. 0.1 0.2 0.3. Higher values give more sequence diversity.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Zero chooses a random seed. Set a nonzero seed for reproducible sampling in the same runtime.

fields.name: backbone_noise
fields.label: Inference backbone noise
fields.help: Standard deviation in angstroms of Gaussian noise added to backbone coordinates during inference; separate from checkpoint training noise.

fields.name: max_length
fields.label: Maximum total sequence length
fields.help: Maximum parsed sequence length across all chains. Longer inputs are rejected before running.

fields.name: fixed_positions_jsonl
fields.label: Fixed positions (JSON)
fields.help: Positions whose native amino acids are retained, e.g. {"A": [1, 2, 3], "C": [10]}. Omitted chains are designed in full.
fields.help_note: Positions are 1-based indices in each parsed chain, including gaps and insertion-code residues, not PDB residue numbers. Enter the chain dictionary or the upstream dictionary keyed by structure name.

fields.name: tied_positions_jsonl
fields.label: Tied positions (JSON)
fields.help: Groups sampled as the same amino acid, e.g. [{"A": [1], "C": [1]}, {"A": [2], "C": [2]}].
fields.help_note: Uses the same 1-based parsed positions. Weighted groups also accept {"A": [[1], [0.5]], "C": [[1], [0.5]]}.

fields.name: homo_oligomer
fields.label: Tie all designed chains as a homo-oligomer
fields.help: Tie matching positions across the designed chains. Requires at least two chains of equal parsed length.
fields.help_note: Convenience equivalent of the official homooligomer helper. Use either this option or custom tied positions.

fields.name: omit_AAs
fields.label: Omit amino acids
fields.help: One-letter amino-acid codes excluded from sampling everywhere, e.g. AC excludes alanine and cysteine. X excludes the unknown residue.

fields.name: bias_AA_jsonl
fields.label: Global amino-acid bias (JSON)
fields.help: Bias for each amino acid, e.g. {"A": -1.1, "F": 0.7}. Positive values favor an amino acid; negative values discourage it.

fields.name: omit_AA_jsonl
fields.label: Per-position omitted amino acids (JSON)
fields.help: Chain-specific exclusions, e.g. {"A": [[[1, 2], "CP"], [[3], "W"]]}. Uses 1-based parsed positions.
fields.help_note: Enter a chain dictionary or an upstream dictionary keyed by structure name. Missing chains have no local exclusions.

fields.name: bias_by_res_jsonl
fields.label: Per-position amino-acid bias (JSON)
fields.help: Chain dictionary of L × 21 numeric bias matrices in alphabet order ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYX. L is the parsed chain length.
fields.help_note: Upload JSON or provide an object through the API. An upstream dictionary keyed by structure name is also accepted. Missing chains receive zero bias.

fields.name: pssm_jsonl
fields.label: PSSM guidance (JSON)
fields.help: Chain dictionaries containing pssm_coef (L), pssm_bias (L × 21 probability distributions), and pssm_log_odds (L × 21). Alphabet: ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYX.
fields.help_note: Use the output of the official make_pssm_input_dict.py helper, or a chain dictionary. The PSSM presets include converted official inputs.

fields.name: pssm_multi
fields.label: PSSM mixing weight
fields.help: Global PSSM weight from 0 to 1, multiplied by each position’s pssm_coef. Zero uses ProteinMPNN alone; one with coefficient one uses PSSM alone.

fields.name: pssm_bias_flag
fields.label: Mix in PSSM probabilities
fields.help: Enable probability mixing using pssm_multi and per-position pssm_coef.

fields.name: pssm_log_odds_flag
fields.label: Restrict amino acids using PSSM log odds
fields.help: Apply the PSSM log-odds mask to sampling.

fields.name: pssm_threshold
fields.label: PSSM log-odds threshold
fields.help: Keep amino acids whose PSSM log odds are greater than this threshold when the log-odds option is enabled.

fields.name: conditional_probs_only_backbone
fields.label: Condition only on the backbone
fields.help: For conditional probabilities, compute p(amino acid | backbone) instead of also conditioning on the other residues.

fields.name: save_score
fields.label: Save sampled sequence scores
fields.help: Save negative log probabilities for designed residues and global scores as NumPy .npz files.

fields.name: save_probs
fields.label: Save sampled sequence probabilities
fields.help: Save per-position probabilities, log probabilities, sequences, masks and chain order as NumPy .npz files.

fields.name: suppress_print
fields.label: Suppress progress output
fields.help: Suppress ProteinMPNN’s progress messages. Result files are still saved.
